# Master Agreement Generator

Curated by Skill Harbor: reproducible contract drafting from a single markdown template plus one small JSON spec per counterparty. Every party-specific value is a placeholder (dates, legal names, jurisdictions, addresses, role-selected fee clauses, schedule rows, signature blocks); everything else is fixed, counsel-approved text, so documents are reproducible from tracked source, diffable, and free of hand edits. Covers NDAs, referral and sourcing-fee agreements, non-circumvention, and master services frameworks, with a Schedule A workflow for adding opportunities by notice once the executed agreement's authority is established. Every output is labeled DRAFT, always, because generating a document proves artifact generation, not legal completeness, authority to contract, or readiness to sign. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: the template must be approved by your own counsel before use; a generated draft is a starting point for review, never a signable document; the tool establishes no authority to contract on your behalf. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
